nodes.label: setEngine()
nodes.rationale: Toggles sqlite vs server field groups and sets default port (3306 MySQL, 5432 PostgreSQL).

nodes.label: q2-fix handler (apply HINT column and rerun)
nodes.norm_label: q2-fix handler (apply hint column and rerun)

nodes.label: runQuery()
nodes.rationale: Preview has no backend: shows spinner then replays sample result after 700ms; bound to Run button, Cmd+Enter and Reconnect.

nodes.label: New connection dialog form
nodes.rationale: Engine select (PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite) swaps between server fields (host, port, database, user, password) and a SQLite file picker; name is the only required field.

nodes.label: save_connection Tauri command
nodes.rationale: Preview has no backend; in the app the Save button invokes this Tauri command.

nodes.label: test_connection Tauri command
nodes.rationale: Preview has no backend; in the app the Test button invokes this Tauri command.

nodes.label: Connection lost state
nodes.rationale: States that nothing was changed and offers Reconnect, which reruns the query.

nodes.label: SQL error state with database HINT fix
nodes.norm_label: sql error state with database hint fix
nodes.rationale: Shows PostgreSQL error verbatim plus a one-click fix applying the HINT (use orders.total and run).

nodes.label: Password kept in macOS login keychain
nodes.norm_label: password kept in macos login keychain
nodes.rationale: Connection passwords are never written to the config file; they live only in the macOS login keychain on this Mac.

nodes.label: SQLite file opened in place, never copied
nodes.norm_label: sqlite file opened in place, never copied
nodes.rationale: The SQLite engine takes a database file path that is opened in place rather than imported or copied.

nodes.label: table.html (Table design preview)
nodes.description: Static design preview of a table tab (public.orders on shop_prod): rows under a where filter, its columns, and its indexes and foreign keys. States: rows, columns, indexes, filter matches nothing, loading.

nodes.label: settings.html (Settings design preview)
nodes.description: Static design preview of the ypacapy Settings dialog over the query screen: theme and colour scheme per appearance, compact mode, three fonts, query defaults, security (passphrase, write guard protection) and where data lives. Note: the Reset to defaults handler (L667-L673) calls $(...).forEach on a single querySelector result and nests apply() inside it, which throws at runtime.

nodes.label: index.html (Query console preview)
nodes.rationale: Design preview of ypacapy, a local-only database explorer for macOS: query console and result grid.

nodes.label: fillCols() (Go to column menu)
nodes.rationale: Likely bug: uses $ (querySelector, single element) then calls .find/.filter/.forEach on the result; should use $$. Same pattern in the #set-reset handler line using $('.res-actions .menu button').forEach.

nodes.label: writeUrl()
nodes.rationale: Every link between screens carries theme, density and font query params so a pick survives navigation.

nodes.label: Connection tabs strip (app-strip / ptabs)
nodes.rationale: Tauri drag region title strip: Home tab plus one tab per open connection, settings button (Cmd+,); leaves 84px empty for native macOS traffic lights.

nodes.label: Connections list (On this Mac)
nodes.rationale: Each connection card shows a colored project tile, name, engine badge (PG/MYSQL/SQLITE), host:port / database or file path, and last-opened time; actions are Open SQLite file and New connection.

nodes.label: Lucide v0.460.0 inline SVG icon sprite
nodes.norm_label: lucide v0.460.0 inline svg icon sprite

nodes.label: Result grid with cell inspector
nodes.rationale: A cell is the unit; inspector shows column, type, row and full value. Header sort only reorders rows already on screen (no new query); row numbers keep database order. Copy/Export as Plain text, JSON, Markdown, CSV.

nodes.label: Schema tree sidebar
nodes.rationale: Schemas > Tables/Views/Functions with filter, row '...' menu (Open rows, New query, Copy name, Truncate, Drop).

nodes.label: voidHTTP design source (fonts/components)
nodes.rationale: Font settings mirror voidHTTP's four font variables plus a table face and size; UI classes (url-field, env-picker, subtabs) are reused from voidHTTP.

nodes.label: Write guard (Run it / Ask to confirm / Ask for passphrase)
nodes.norm_label: write guard (run it / ask to confirm / ask for passphrase)
nodes.rationale: Per-connection gate before a write runs; lowering from passphrase/Touch ID level asks for the passphrase first.

nodes.label: window.YpaThemes (themes.js scheme API)
nodes.rationale: Loaded from ./themes.js; exposes SCHEMES, BUILTIN, DEFAULT_SCHEME, FAMILIES, findScheme, isDark, schemeTokens, schemeSwatch used by every preview screen.

nodes.label: Settings Appearance pane
nodes.rationale: Theme Auto/Light/Dark with a separate colour scheme slot per appearance (both slots shown under Auto, one under Light or Dark), Compact mode switch, and three font+size pickers (Interface font --font-ui, Table font --font-table, Query console font --font-mono) with a live sample and Reset to defaults.

nodes.label: Result grid with cell inspector and on-screen sort
nodes.norm_label: result grid with cell inspector and on-screen sort
nodes.rationale: A cell is the unit: click or arrow keys select it and the inspector below shows column, type, row and full value. Header sort reorders only the rows already on screen (no new query); row numbers keep the database order.

nodes.label: Write guard picker (Run it / Ask to confirm / Ask for passphrase)
nodes.norm_label: write guard picker (run it / ask to confirm / ask for passphrase)
nodes.rationale: Per-connection guard in the tabs bar with levels run, confirm, verify; lowering from Ask for passphrase asks for the passphrase first.

nodes.label: Table Indexes and Foreign keys view
nodes.norm_label: table indexes and foreign keys view

nodes.label: Table Rows view (paged, 20 per page)
nodes.rationale: Grid with primary-key and foreign-key markers in headers, typed cells (ts, json, null pill), inspector, copy/export menus (plain text, JSON, Markdown table, CSV) and prev/next paging.

nodes.label: Table where-clause filter
nodes.rationale: Request line holds a free-form where clause (default status in ('paid','shipped','refunded')); Run, Enter or Cmd+Enter re-reads the rows. An empty result explains which values the column holds and offers Clear the filter.

nodes.label: Local-only config in ~/.config/ypacapy
nodes.rationale: Everything stays on this Mac; connection definitions are kept locally in ~/.config/ypacapy.

nodes.label: Estimated row counts from table statistics
nodes.norm_label: estimated row counts from table statistics
nodes.rationale: Table counts show '~12k' style estimates from table statistics instead of running count(*), keeping automatic queries light.

nodes.label: Preview state carried in URL
nodes.rationale: Every link between preview screens carries theme mode, light/dark scheme, OS appearance, density and font query params (show is dropped) so a pick survives jumping between static pages.

nodes.label: Estimated row count (~12k from table statistics)
nodes.norm_label: estimated row count (~12k from table statistics)
nodes.rationale: Row counts in the tab and schema tree are shown as estimates from table statistics (marked with ~) rather than running count(*), keeping automatic queries cheap.

nodes.label: Settings Data on this Mac pane
nodes.norm_label: settings data on this mac pane
nodes.rationale: Local-only storage disclosure: settings in ~/.config/ypacapy/settings.toml, connections (no passwords) in ~/.config/ypacapy/connections.toml, history and saved queries in ~/.config/ypacapy/ypacapy.db, passwords in the macOS login keychain (never synced to iCloud), network only to the databases you add.

nodes.label: Settings Queries pane
nodes.rationale: Row limit 500 (added to a select with no limit of its own), statement timeout 30 s, open new connections read-only, keep query history, and an opt-in connection heartbeat (select 1 every N s, below the server idle timeout) whose interval row exists only while it is on.

nodes.label: Graph freshness hooks (PostToolUse + git post-commit)
nodes.rationale: A PostToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json and a git post-commit hook run graphify update . so the graph tracks code changes; other agents and shell edits must run it themselves. graphify update only re-reads structure, so large doc changes or package.json/tsconfig.json changes need /graphify . --update to restore LLM-extracted concepts.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md (symlink to AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md so Claude Code and other agents read one identical instruction file.

nodes.label: Read the graph first workflow
nodes.rationale: Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md at task start and query the graph (graphify query, query --dfs, path, explain) before grepping; then open the files to confirm. Only EXTRACTED edges are facts; INFERRED and AMBIGUOUS need checking.

nodes.label: ypacapy App Icon
nodes.description: 1024x1024 SVG app icon: rounded-square tile (rx 184) with diagonal blue gradient background and a white stroked database cylinder glyph centered on it. Signals the app is a database tool.

nodes.label: Blue Gradient Rounded Tile
nodes.rationale: linearGradient 'bg' from #5b8ff8 (top-left) to #1840ab (bottom-right) on an 824px rounded square inset 100px from the canvas, following macOS app-icon grid with padding.

nodes.label: Database Cylinder Glyph
nodes.rationale: Classic DB cylinder (top ellipse, body, one mid band = two-tier stack) drawn as white 44px round-capped strokes, no fill; universal database metaphor identifies ypacapy as a database client/explorer.

nodes.label: index.html (Vite app entry)
nodes.description: Root HTML shell titled ypacapy, a local-only database explorer for macOS; mounts #root and loads /src/main.tsx as a module.

nodes.label: Passphrase sub-dialogs (set, change, disable, unlock)
nodes.rationale: Set asks twice and warns it cannot be recovered; change and disable need the current passphrase; disabling makes connections on Ask for passphrase fall back to Ask to confirm and turns Touch ID off. The preview only checks fields are filled and match; the app checks against the keychain.

nodes.label: Settings Security pane
nodes.rationale: Passphrase (stored in the macOS keychain) gates Open with Touch ID and Stay unlocked for (ask every time, 1/5/15 min). Each connection sets its own write guard in the tabs bar; Security only owns the passphrase and the protected-statement list.

nodes.label: What to protect (protected statement kinds)
nodes.rationale: Switches for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, REPLACE (MySQL), ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE, CREATE, GRANT, REVOKE. Locked by default; unlocking takes the passphrase once and lasts until Settings closes or Lock is pressed, so the protection list cannot be weakened casually.
